# Blodrött på Wall Street och i Asien – därför rasar börserna

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-11-06  
**Market Sentiment**: Negative

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon (6 Nov 2026) covers a sharp global sell-off: the S&P 500 fell 4.4% and the Nasdaq 5.5%, led by AI and chip stocks, and Japan's Topix dropped about 6%. The hosts link the fall to post-election worries that a Democratic sweep will slow the data-center build-out, credit stress around data-center financing, and possible forced selling. Several Nordic companies reported strong numbers (BTS, Orkla, Attendo, Clas Ohlson), but the hosts doubt the market will reward them on a day like this.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 BTS-B — BTS | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Record Q3 well above estimates, EBITDA +76%, AI-implementation work presented as a success; hosts doubt it gets rewarded on a weak market day.

#### Reasoning

The hosts call this a strong comeback for CEO Jessica Skon after a long slide, and note the company has gone from being seen as an AI loser to pitching itself as an AI winner. The stock is up 57% YTD but still well below earlier highs. There is no explicit buy call, and the market sell-off may hide the strong report in the short term.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q3 strength proves one-off
- if AI consulting demand fades
- if broad market sell-off deepens

> *"Det är det starkaste Q3 i bolagets historia och ser ut att vara ganska mycket starkare än vad analytikerna hade väntat sig."*

---

### 🟠 CLAS-B — Clas Ohlson | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

October organic sales +12%, total +19%; stock +20% in a month and +70% YTD as the expected slowdown keeps failing to show up.

#### Reasoning

The hosts keep expecting sales to slow, but they keep beating that view. The momentum is strong, but after +70% YTD the valuation is stretched and there is no explicit recommendation, so this is momentum to watch rather than a buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if monthly sales growth decelerates
- if consumer demand weakens
- if market-wide de-rating hits momentum names

> *"Man tänker att försäljningen kommer att bromsa in, men det gör den inte. Det här ser också väldigt starkt ut."*

---

### 🟠 ATT — Attendo | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Broad beat in the new CEO's first report (Q3 profit SEK 706M) and buybacks starting.

#### Reasoning

The report beat expectations across the board, and buybacks will support the shares. The hosts only report this without giving an opinion, so the signal is weak.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margins revert
- if buyback is halted
- if political/regulatory pressure on care sector increases

> *"Man slår förväntningarna på bred front"*

---

### 🟠 7974 — Nintendo | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Weak report, shares -9%; open question whether the new Zelda can turn the pressured stock.

#### Reasoning

High component costs and few new game releases hurt the report. The hosts ask whether the upcoming Zelda title for Switch 2 can change direction, which makes it a possible catalyst to watch but not a conviction call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Zelda launch disappoints
- if component costs keep rising

> *"Frågan är om det nya Zelda åker in off-time-spelet i Switch 2 ska bli en riktningsändrare i den just nu ganska pressade aktien."*

---
